hero.title: Hi, I'm Sakin!
hero.des0: I'm a Software Engineer with a keen focus on building high-performance, full-stack cross-platform applications powered by AI and modern development frameworks.

projects.title: Projects
projects.description: Here are some of my favourite projects that I've lead and developed collaborating with a team or alone. Most of the projects were build to address real-world scenarios.

tryOnAI.subtitle: TryOnAI Chatbot
tryOnAI.description: A virtual clothing try-on AI chatbot that can be seamlessly integrated into websites.

tryOn.subtitle: TryOn Chrome Extension
tryOn.description: A chrome extension that lets you virtually try on clothes on Amazon, Facebook, Instagram, etc., using AI.

snipClip.subtitle: SnipClip
snipClip.description: Get your audio/video clip from a video (with multiple speakers) by adding a reference audio.

ytchat.subtitle: Chat with Youtube Videos
ytchat.description: A platform that lets you chat with YouTube videos using Generative AI.

cms.subtitle: Complaint Management System
cms.description: Led the development of a complaint management system in collaboration with a college mate that enables community members to submit, interact, and track complaints.
